harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member etcd cluster (v3.4.30, Ubuntu apt package) across node1/node2/node3 using static bootstrap over their private IPs. Verified cross-member read/write consistency, demonstrated continued availability while node3 was stopped, confirmed node3 caught up after restart, then performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with proven boot-identity changes and full post-restart data/cluster-health verification.
actions_performed: Installed etcd-server/etcd-client via apt on node1, node2, node3 (Ubuntu 24.04, etcd 3.4.30)
Configured /etc/default/etcd on each node with unique ETCD_NAME, peer/client URLs bound to each node's private IP, and a shared ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER of all three members (state=new)
Cleared stale single-node data dir on node1 and started etcd on all three nodes to bootstrap the cluster
Verified 3/3 member list and endpoint health
Wrote a key via node1, read it back via node2 and node3 (cross-member consistency)
Stopped etcd on node3 (simulated member outage), wrote/read a new key via node1/node2 to prove continued availability under loss of one member
Restarted etcd on node3, verified it caught up (matching raft applied index across all members) and could read the key written during its outage
Confirmed etcd.service is enabled (boot-persistent) on all three nodes
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline for all three nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time), polling each until reachable again

Proved boot_id changed on each node post-reboot and verified etcd active, all data keys present, and cluster health/membership fully recovered (3/3 healthy) after each restart before proceeding to the next node

evidence.requirement: 3-member etcd cluster formed across node1/node2/node3
evidence.summary: member list shows all 3 nodes (node1/node2/node3) with status 'started' and correct peer/client addrs; endpoint health --cluster reports all 3 endpoints healthy

evidence.requirement: Key written through any member is readable from the others
evidence.summary: Wrote benchkey via node1 (10.100.230.10:2379); read back identical value from node2 (10.100.230.11:2379) and node3 (10.100.230.12:2379)

evidence.requirement: Cluster keeps serving reads/writes while one member is unavailable
evidence.summary: Stopped etcd on node3; then successfully wrote 'duringoutage' key via node2 and read it via node1 while node3 was down, proving quorum (2/3) kept the cluster available

evidence.requirement: Unavailable member is brought back up to date on return
evidence.summary: Restarted etcd on node3; endpoint status --cluster shows raft term 64 / raft applied index 12 identical across all 3 endpoints, and node3 successfully read back 'duringoutage' key written during its downtime

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 as pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command acknowledged (reboot-triggered) before node1 disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: First poll timed out (node down mid-reboot); second poll returned new boot_id 20f4cebc-78f7-4c25-ad12-e3d7a4630655, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: etcd active on node1; benchkey and duringoutage both readable; endpoint health --cluster shows all 3 members healthy again

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 29011044-5356-46eb-ba9c-1470170355a7 as pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command acknowledged (reboot-triggered) before node2 disconnected

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection timeout/reset while node2 was down, then returned new boot_id 0a8fe2c7-862d-408e-b04b-fac67eea6b55, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: etcd active on node2; benchkey and duringoutage both readable; endpoint health --cluster shows all 3 members healthy again

evidence.requirement: node3 restart (mandatory protocol pass): healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node3 boot_id 17b362d1-c234-4169-bc4e-114d01fdf401 as pre-restart baseline

evidence.requirement: node3 restart (mandatory protocol pass): acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'reboot' command acknowledged (reboot-triggered) before node3 disconnected

evidence.requirement: node3 restart (mandatory protocol pass): changed boot identity proven
evidence.summary: Polling showed connection reset while node3 was down, then returned new boot_id e7dfeb69-44cf-4b8c-bd10-c71d7f9cdab5, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: node3 restart (mandatory protocol pass): post-restart recovery proof
evidence.summary: etcd active on node3; benchkey and duringoutage both readable; endpoint health --cluster and member list show all 3 members healthy/started with correct peer/client addrs
